mathematical_meanings: Left image: The trace represents a linear relation assigning equal coordinates along the trace. Right image: The straight segment is the diagonal connecting the lower-left and upper-right corners.
Rationales: The feature plots a linear relationship between coordinates in the left image and connects opposite vertices of a quadrilateral in the right image. The rising trace through the origin from the lower-left to the upper-right of the plot. The rising straight line inside the rectangle.
